newsitem.title: USA: Supreme Industries declares stock dividend.
newsitem.headline: Supreme Industries declares stock dividend.

text.p: Supreme Industries Inc said Thursday its board of directors declared a five percent stock dividend on its outstanding class A common stock.
The dividend is payable on May 19 to shareholders of record on May 12. Cash will be paid in lieu of fractional shares, the company said.
As of April 29, 1997, Supreme Industries had 9,392,324 shares of common stock outstanding, consisting of 7,989,349 shares of class A and 1,402,975 shares of class B, the company said.
Supreme Industries is a manufacturer of specialized truck bodies which are produced to the specifications of its customers.
